basics.name: Sami Lindroos
basics.label: PO / Scrum Master / AI & Agentic Delivery
basics.summary:
Sami is not only an experienced PO/SM and coach, but also a recognized specialist in combining AI, agentic development and teamwork — passionately driving how organizations build software and teams collaborate in the AI era.

With a background in software development and product ownership, he brings an end-to-end perspective from value definition to delivery. He actively explores how software development is evolving in the AI era and how organizations can adapt their ways of working to move forward in an increasingly AI-assisted and agentic environment — translating emerging possibilities into practical ways of working. He uses AI in daily work through workflows, structured prompting, and agent-like ways of working to support smart teamwork, requirements, prioritization, and decision-making.

His approach combines product ownership mindset, facilitation, and delivery leadership to ensure that the right things are built — and delivered.

x-strengths.title: AI and Agentic delivery visionary
x-strengths.description: Sami is one of the few professionals in his field who is genuinely passionate about helping organizations move forward with AI and agentic development. He helps teams and leaders make sense of the AI-driven shift with a product-ownership mindset and a collaborative way of working. His background in software development and experience of different AI tools gives him an end-to-end view from value definition to delivery.

x-strengths.title: Delivery, alignment, and collaboration
x-strengths.description: He helps teams and stakeholders align priorities, improve ways of working, and drive steady delivery, with roots in interaction design and human–computer interaction.

x-strengths.title: Clarity, collaboration, progress
x-strengths.description: Sami helps teams and leaders make sense of complexity with a product-ownership mindset and a collaborative way of working. He connects customer needs, business goals, and delivery — turning strategy into clear priorities and actionable decisions. His background in software development and AI tools gives him an end-to-end view from value definition to delivery.

Also provided internal agile training and sparring for colleagues and supported other client projects with agile coaching when needed.

work.name: Kvanta Consulting Oy
work.summary: Worked as software developer in multiple client projects, focusing on web development and digital services.

work.name: Turbo Digital
work.summary: Worked on web solutions for clients in print media, telecommunications, and cybersecurity. Focused on frontend development and UI design.

projects.name: AI Development Agent (MVP)
projects.description: Led concepting and service design for an AI-powered “development agent” to support early-stage ideation and decision-making. Defined the concept, structure, and workflow supporting ideation, benchmarking, and evaluation. Facilitated workshops with stakeholders to clarify needs and translate goals into a concrete MVP, structuring input into actionable insights. Aligned business goals, user needs, and technical possibilities to support decision-making and next steps.

projects.name: B2B eCommerce renewal
projects.description: Worked as Agile Coach in the renewal of the client's B2B eCommerce, supporting delivery across teams and stakeholders. Helped product owners clarify value and align priorities across Online and Salesforce units, ensuring decisions and next steps were grounded in business needs. Facilitated prioritization and cross-unit workshops to keep direction shared and delivery moving. Simplified the end-to-end development flow, increased transparency across the pipeline, and used AI tools to support clarity and decision-making.

projects.name: Mortgage system renewal
projects.description: Worked as Scrum Master / Project Manager in the renewal of the bank's mortgage system. Supported requirement definition for Salesforce and online initiatives where clarity of scope and priorities was critical. Helped product owners refine requirements, assess options, and prioritize work so that business needs translated into clear development tasks. Facilitated collaboration between analysts, developers, and stakeholders to keep priorities visible and delivery aligned with business goals.

projects.name: B2B data analytics initiative
projects.description: Worked as Scrum Master for a development team in a B2B data analytics initiative. Partnered with product owners and business stakeholders to clarify value and shape backlog items, translating high-level needs into actionable work for the team. The team developed analytics solutions to strengthen collaboration between Kauppatalo Oyj and its suppliers, improve supply chain visibility, and support data-driven decisions. Facilitated requirement work and team practices to ensure clarity and steady progress, strengthening collaboration between business and development.

projects.name: Analytics data team
projects.description: Scrum Master for a data team building AWS-based analytics solutions for Northpeak Sports. Worked globally with the group's brands in France and Canada. Worked closely with business counterparts to clarify reporting needs and ensure development focused on insights with the highest business value.

projects.name: Scaling Scrum in web development
projects.description: Sami led the web development team and co-created a process to scale Scrum across the entire development department. His work improved cross-team collaboration, increased transparency, and strengthened agile understanding throughout the organization.

projects.name: Large-scale agile workshop
projects.description: Co-designed and delivered a large-scale remote workshop on agile practices for hundreds of participants over several days. Facilitated interactive sessions and exercises that introduced agile principles across roles and departments, helping the organization build shared understanding and a common language. Supported product owners in building shared understanding of value and priorities during cross-team collaboration and large-scale workshops.

projects.name: Digital services unit
projects.description: Served as Agile Coach and Scrum Master in the city's digital services unit. Supported multiple teams developing online services through API-based solutions. Supported product owners in maintaining clarity of goals and priorities across API-based development work.

projects.name: Other agile coaching assignments
projects.description: Included smaller assignments for Keskinäinen Vakuutus Kataja, Saarieläintarha and Kiinteistö Hirvi Oy, where the focus was on supporting agile adoption and delivery practices.

projects.name: Mobile development team in the digital unit
projects.description: Scrum Master for a mobile development team (iOS/Android) in the airline's digital unit. The unit developed all consumer-facing services from booking and payments to the mobile app, ancillary products, and supporting backend systems. Contributed also to the unit-wide agile ways of working together with 2–3 other Scrum Masters, including planning and facilitation of PI plannings for around eight teams. Worked with business owners and multiple teams to strengthen collaboration and establish shared agile practices across the unit.

projects.name: New mobile banking app
projects.description: Agile Coach for multiple teams developing the retail bank's new mobile banking and loyalty app (iOS, Android, backend, design, and service design). Focused on agile practices, improving delivery quality, and accelerating pace together with business and development stakeholders.

projects.name: Growth hacking initiative
projects.description: Facilitated a growth hacking initiative exploring new opportunities in lending, credit, and investment services. Applied Lean, Kanban, and dynamic facilitation methods to identify improvements and new business potential.

projects.name: Scaling Scrum across the development department
projects.description: Led the web development team and co-created a process to scale Scrum across the whole development department. Helped teams improve cross-team collaboration, increase transparency, and build a stronger understanding of agile practices throughout the organization. Supported both team delivery and department-wide alignment as the organization scaled.

projects.name: Consumer website renewal
projects.description: Developer in the renewal of the bank's main consumer website, contributing to both frontend and backend implementation. Collaborated with business stakeholders and designers to improve usability and reliability of online banking services.

projects.name: Other client assignments
projects.description: Contributed to projects as a developer for Taajuus Drives Oy, Kauppatalo Kone, Pankkitieto Oy, Säätieto Oy and Sähkötukku Oy, building and maintaining customer-facing digital solutions.
